prompt: Describe ownership choices only. A worker just completed a parser node with compact, current context. Also describe what changes if parser context is stale or crowded. Do not execute.
assertions: Allows cost-justified reuse for a closely related node with separate ownership and acceptance.
Revalidates routing and current context before reuse.
Uses fresh context for unrelated or stale/crowded work and retains necessary evidence.
